output.reason: The linked PR [ev-35660f951eec] names the subject: the `--skip-resources-with-label` flag of the admin backup/restore CLI, which touches only cmd/argocd/commands/admin/backup.go [ev-d2e67a4dcbd8]. It also states the bug: using that flag made the restore prune live resources, which could cause an outage. After the fix, live resources carrying the ignore label are not pruned when they are missing from the backup. Exposure is therefore limited to operators who run admin import with that flag. The PR says the bug was introduced by #21694, which added the flag and is listed in the same 3.0.0 changelog [ev-a5b549ff42a5], so the bug was likely introduced and fixed within the same release.
